correctness.rationale: Direct derivation from the original floor recurrence yields s*g=g-u+delta, g(n)=2n-1, including base n=1 and n=2. Mod-2 Dirichlet inversion gives s=mu mod 2. For squarefree n the truncated Boolean ring has invertible constant-one series, and coefficient extraction is exact: t_j=2(-1)^j F_j follows from 1/(2e^z-1)=2/(2-e^{-z})-1. This gives the signed Fubini elementary-symmetric formula, exact r=1 boundary and strict r>=2 bound. Independent standard-library computation agrees on 40,000 indices, but the proof is infinite.
